import trimesh, numpy as np
raw=trimesh.load_mesh("exports/model.lid.6029fe16.stl",process=False)
verts,inv=np.unique(raw.vertices[raw.faces].reshape(-1,3),axis=0,return_inverse=True)
m=trimesh.Trimesh(verts,inv.reshape(-1,3),process=False)
print("watertight",m.is_watertight,"euler",m.euler_number)
comps=trimesh.graph.connected_components(m.face_adjacency,nodes=np.arange(len(m.faces)),min_len=1)
tri=m.triangles
signed=np.einsum("ij,ij->i",tri[:,0],np.cross(tri[:,1],tri[:,2]))/6
for c in comps:
    print("shell faces",len(c),"vol",round(float(signed[c].sum()),2),"bounds",np.round(m.vertices[m.faces[c]].reshape(-1,3).min(0),2),np.round(m.vertices[m.faces[c]].reshape(-1,3).max(0),2))
